findings.message: Unsupported: No continuous effect grants one player control of another player (CR 720). ControlBy changes control of an object, not of a player, and there is no record for a control effect that lasts only while a player is performing a search.

Unsupported: Nothing replaces the cards a search finds with an exile (the Searches trigger fires after the search and cannot alter what it found), and no record grants a play permission for those exiled cards for as long as they remain exiled, nor 'spend mana as though it were mana of any color'.
